description: A fungal disease that attacks flowers and young fruits of many vegetables, especially cucurbits and legumes. It causes rapid flower rot and fruit decay under warm and humid conditions.
symptoms: Cottony white fungal growth on infected tissues
Black pin-like spores forming on rotting flowers
Infected flowers stick to developing fruits and cause fruit rot
favorable_conditions: Dense canopy with poor air circulation
spread: Contact between infected flowers and fruits
management: Remove and destroy infected flowers and fruits
Improve plant spacing to increase airflow
Harvest regularly to remove infected tissues
biological_control: Trichoderma harzianum as a soil or foliar biocontrol agent
prevention: Avoid excess irrigation and prolonged leaf wetness
Use healthy seeds and maintain field sanitation
source: University of Florida IFAS Plant Pathology
